answer_1.quote: The task of controllable text revision, i.e., rephrasing text to a targeted style or framing
answer_1.outputs: revised sentences with targeted agency levels

answer_2.quote: we also use a variety of automated evaluation metrics to characterize different aspects of performance. We measure the accuracy of the change in agency ... meaning preservation ... BERTscore F1 ... fluency ... perplexity ... repetitiveness ... fraction of output sentences that have a bigram that is repeated two or more times ... diversity ... fraction of generations that are unique

answer_4.quote: we obtain human judgments of model performance through crowdsourcing ... We design a head-to-head crowdsourcing task on Amazon Mechanical Turk where we ask raters to compare two outputs ... we first ask them to judge whether either output is gibberish, then, in two questions, choose which revision has better targeted agency and which better preserves the meaning
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare outputs and select which has better targeted agency and better meaning preservation
